row: Dr. Natasha – Tails + Trails Animal Chiropractor

***Sacramento's only AVCA Certified Animal Chiropractor*** H! I’m Dr. Natasha and nothing makes me happier than helping an animal in need and preventing their pain or suffering. I love adjusting dogs and horses using gentle techniques that honor the animal and how they’re feeling. In terms of education – since 2011, I've been mentored by one of the best animal chiropractors in the world. In 2015, I received my Doctorate in Chiropractic (human). I continued my training with 300-hours of post-doctoral specialization in Animal Chiropractic. I am Board-Certified by the American Veterinary Chiropractic Association (AVCA).
